coordinateSystem: WGS84 longitude/latitude source projected to spherical Web Mercator meters and encoded as XYZ vector tiles at build time

geometryPolicy.antimeridian: Normalize longitudes and split polygon rings at the 180th meridian before projection.
geometryPolicy.polarDetail: Features touching latitudes outside the safe vector latitude are rejected and listed in the geometry audit; the local country overview remains the fallback there.
geometryPolicy.worldSpanningFeatures: Rejected after component splitting rather than emitted as a world-spanning fill.

coveragePolicy.adm1: Global composite administrative level 1 from geoBoundaries CGAZ; displayed as reference geometry.
coveragePolicy.adm2: Global composite administrative level 2 from geoBoundaries CGAZ; displayed as reference geometry.
coveragePolicy.places: GeoNames cities500 populated-place reference points; source is CC BY and is not a complete locality census.
coveragePolicy.disputedAreas: CGAZ global composite policy follows the source project; Atlas does not infer sovereignty.

source.dataset: CGAZ plus country-specific gbOpen administrative levels where available
source.license: Per-source attribution and license metadata are preserved per layer
